# Results summary (generated by tools/summarize.py)

## Rate-distortion on iid N(0,1) (wasted bits = R - R*(D), lower is better)

Source: `results/rd_gaussian.json` (512k values). Pearl's numbers are read off their Fig. 5.

| point | Pearl's Fig. 5 | ours, no side info | ours, free exact per-vector norm | ours, incl. fp16 scale (the codec we ship) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PQ 2.75 bpv | 0.39 | 0.378 | 0.331 | 0.445 |
| PQ 3.75 bpv | 0.42 | 0.479 | 0.373 | 0.494 |
| TurboQuant-MSE 3 b | 0.56 | 0.558 (our re-run) | | |
| TurboQuant-MSE 4 b | 0.60 | 0.630 (our re-run) | | |
| NVFP4 4.5 bpv | 1.15 | 1.106 (our re-run) | | |
| FP8 e4m3 8 bpv | 2.65 | 2.762 (our re-run) | | |

HyperQuant E8 + Rice (variable rate, interpolated): 2.75 bpv -> 0.303, 3.75 bpv -> 0.265.
Voronoi (NestQuant) code at 2.75 bpv incl. scale: 0.529 vs ball 0.445.
